label: Component outputs do not identify required fit, nor natural reports operative plan coverage
paraphrase: In a Boolean structural model, a fixed conjunctive plan requires both component outputs and their end-placement fit. Two contexts agree on the outputs but differ on fit and hence success; the component report cannot identify fulfillment, while the full report can. In the paired practical-plan and mechanism controls, the same natural reports and populated appraisal and satisfaction coexist with opposite operative coverage. With one public input withdrawn the two profiles differ; the augmented report identifies coverage in this supplied pairing, and the nonempty intervention selector expresses the same local contrast. No real-world applicability or general reduction of practical direction to intervention sensitivity is asserted.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Show, for the actual source of distinct giving, which admissible evidence identifies an apprehended plan that actually governs that giving (operative coverage in 4be0f774) rather than one that is merely appraised and satisfied, and that the same plan requires the recipient's fit and not only its component outputs.
connection_plan.blocker: The Boolean fit and appraisal reports and the pairing of Plan and SCM profiles are stipulated, not actual source-to-good calibration. A noncognitive joint-manifestation account remains possible within the selected formal comparison.
